metadata.description: The vitest-auto-spy plugin — an agent skill for writing tests with typed auto-spies. Installing it needs no files in your project; the skill shipped in the npm tarball is not auto-discovered.

plugins.name: vitest-auto-spy
plugins.description: Teaches an agent to write and fix tests that use vitest-auto-spy: typed spies from a class or a type on Vitest, bun:test and node:test, with Angular/NestJS/React/Vue/Svelte adapters, an ESLint plugin and a jest-auto-spies migration codemod.
